    // A function-form __index generic in a key whose domain is still generic where the pairing
    // forms contributes the generic mapped type it spells. The registry-derived client shape from
    // the report: the procedure names are a conditional over the prefix, unknowable in the body.
    
    type ReproRealm = "server" | "client"
    
    interface ReproProcedure<TInput, TOutput, TRealm extends ReproRealm> {
        input?: TInput;
        output?: TOutput;
        realm: TRealm;
    }
    
    type ReproRegisteredRouter<TPrefix extends string, TRoutes> = TRoutes & {
        __routerType?: {
            prefix: TPrefix;
            routes: TRoutes;
        };
    }
    
    interface ReproModules {
        first: ReproRegisteredRouter<"service", {
            ping: ReproProcedure<{ value: number }, string, "server">;
            pushed: ReproProcedure<{}, boolean, "client">;
        }>;
    
        second: ReproRegisteredRouter<"other", {
            lookup: ReproProcedure<{ id: string }, number, "server">;
        }>;
    }
    
    type ReproProcedureNames<
        TPrefix extends string,
        TRealm extends ReproRealm
    > = {
        [TModuleName in keyof ReproModules]:
            ReproModules[TModuleName] extends {
                __routerType?: {
                    prefix: TPrefix;
                    routes: infer TRoutes;
                };
            }
                ? {
                    [TName in keyof TRoutes]:
                        TRoutes[TName] extends
                            ReproProcedure<unknown, unknown, TRealm>
                                ? TName
                                : never;
                }[keyof TRoutes]
                : never;
    }[keyof ReproModules];
    
    type ReproProcedureAt<
        TPrefix extends string,
        TRealm extends ReproRealm,
        TName
    > = {
        [TModuleName in keyof ReproModules]:
            ReproModules[TModuleName] extends {
                __routerType?: {
                    prefix: TPrefix;
                    routes: infer TRoutes;
                };
            }
                ? TName extends keyof TRoutes
                    ? TRoutes[TName] extends
                        ReproProcedure<unknown, unknown, TRealm>
                            ? TRoutes[TName]
                            : never
                    : never
                : never;
    }[keyof ReproModules];
    
    type ReproOutput<TProcedure> =
        TProcedure extends
            ReproProcedure<unknown, infer TOutput, ReproRealm>
                ? TOutput
                : never;
    
    type ReproCaller<TProcedure> =
        () => ReproOutput<TProcedure>;
    
    type ReproClient<
        TPrefix extends string,
        TRealm extends ReproRealm
    > = {
        [TName in ReproProcedureNames<TPrefix, TRealm>]:
            ReproCaller<
                ReproProcedureAt<TPrefix, TRealm, TName>
            >;
    };
    
    declare function reproBuildCaller<
        TPrefix extends string,
        TName extends
            ReproProcedureNames<TPrefix, "server"> & string
    >(
        prefix: TPrefix,
        name: TName
    ): ReproClient<TPrefix, "server">[TName];
    
    function reproConnect<TPrefix extends string>(
        prefix: TPrefix
    ): ReproClient<TPrefix, "server">
        return setmetatable({}, {
            __index = function<
                K extends
                    ReproProcedureNames<TPrefix, "server"> & string
            >(
                _: table,
                key: K
            ): ReproClient<TPrefix, "server">[K]
                return reproBuildCaller<TPrefix, K>(prefix, key);
            end
        });
    end
    
    local client = reproConnect("service");
    local result: string = client.ping();
    local wrong: number = client.ping();
